downstream_modifications: Require Python 3.12 and the exact CRISPRidentify-tested runtime dependency versions.
Require setuptools 77 or newer for the PEP 639 license expression and include complete Apache-2.0 license material.
Fail closed by verifying top-level and nested model manifests, sizes, and SHA-256 values before inference.
Emit deterministic profile_families evidence derived from bundled profile metadata.

Make the genome evidence gate type-aware for subtype-null Type VII candidates and report their type_vote_fraction confidence with the direct_profile_type_aggregation method, without weakening other type gates.
Normalize independent protein class/type/subtype head winners into hierarchy-consistent output while preserving raw classifications and explicit conflict evidence.

Normalize final cassette class/type/subtype claims after both direct-profile aggregation and architecture classification, preserve the raw claims and explicit conflict evidence, apply the genome gate to the normalized claim, and report a per-run masked-conflict count.
Use the local version suffix +crispridentify.3 to distinguish this downstream integration.
